items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: At the time we first got Eppie, we were using two bass players.

ctx.x: Where did you get Eppie from. I thought Eppie was from Kansas City.
We didn't get him in Kansas City. At the time we first got Eppie, we were using two bass players.
You mean Brent Sparks and Eppie?
